title.narrative: Support for MONUSCO Radio Okapi in Democratic Republic of the Congo

description.narrative: UNOPS provides administrative support to the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (MONUSCO) Radio Okapi, the United Nations radio in the Democratic Republic of Congo. It first went on the air on 25 February 2002 from Kinshasa studios to the entire DRC territory. Radio Okapi was created with the purpose of accompanying the peace process in the country. It broadcasts nationwide and nearly covers the whole country with frequency modulation, broadcasting a wide range of programs: news, education and entertainments in the four local languages (Swahili, Lingala, Kikongo and Tshiluba) as well as in French in order to serve the largest public possible in DRC.
